title: Zero-User Curriculum Learning and Evidence-Gated Autonomous Research
summary: KESPA operationalized a scheduled zero-user learning driver that selects research opportunities from an explicit curriculum and other gap signals, queues asynchronous research work, and keeps Trusted Knowledge promotion and public publication independently fail-closed. The first recorded production daily-learning run completed and queued four public research requests; 24 curriculum domains were enabled, a 30-day maximum verification-age safeguard was active, background lifecycle workers were scheduled, and the production readiness audit reported zero failures with one non-blocking storage warning. Full downstream completion of every queued research request and large-scale autonomous promotion remain outside this verified checkpoint.

readiness_audit.warning: External S3-compatible artifact storage not configured; local encrypted storage remained active.
